name: mammoth-analytics
description: Explore, clean, transform and export your Mammoth Analytics data.

interface.longDescription:
Mammoth Analytics turns messy data into clean datasets, views and dashboards.

Upload a file or connect a database, look through your datasets, clean and transform them with repeatable pipelines, get exact totals, build dashboards, and send the results where they need to go.

You need a Mammoth account. Every action runs as you, with your own permissions, and Mammoth asks you before anything is sent out or published.
defaultPrompt: List my Mammoth datasets and tell me which needs cleaning.
Combine two of my datasets and total revenue by region.
Build a dashboard from one of my Mammoth views.
